Scripts that rely on correct label metadata (e.g., `reconcile_managed_issue_labels` in `orchestrate_lib.py`) will create or repair labels with incorrect metadata, creating visual/operational inconsistency across repositories.; **ISSUE 3 — CONTRACT CONTRADICTION: Documentation references labels that are no longer in the helper catalog**; Files affected:; - README.md (new section 13b and 13c); - agents.md (new bullet points under GitHub API hygiene and label-repair gates); The new documentation states:; - "Additional failure labels in `.github/ai/label_contract.v1.json` (ai:clarify-failed, ...) are contract-defined/reserved on this branch; they are recognized by repair/status helpers but are not yet actively emitted by their phase workflows."; - The env-var gates (`ENABLE_PHASE_FAILURE_COMMENTS`, `ENABLE_LABEL_REPAIR_SWEEP`, etc.) are described as contract-defined/reserved with "current branch behavior does not consume the gate yet."; However, the `repair/status helpers` (`ensure_label_exists` and label reconciliation) depend on the helper catalog to supply correct colors/descriptions.
